description: A TFR read for a pilot, on the lines a NOTAM's row has, from what tfr.faa.gov gives of it: its kind as a heading ("Security TFR"), what it is with the rule it is issued under ("Security TFR, 14 CFR 99.7": 14 CFR 91.137-91.145, 99.7; 49 U.S.C. 44812), where it is (its floor to its ceiling in whole feet, rounded outward, each MSL or AGL as its XNOTAM gives it, the ground said as surface; and over the field, or how far its nearest edge is from the field and which way, to a tenth of a mile rounded down, on JO 7930.2 3-3-9's 16 points), and its place's name from the list's title, its dates off (the card says them once). A kind or rule it does not know is said as given, never guessed.

kind.description: tfr.faa.gov's kind ("Security", "Hazards", "Vip", "Space Operations", "Air Shows/Sports", "Uas Public Gathering").

rule.description: The rule as tfr_detail_read names it ("special security instructions (99.7)") or its code.

title.description: The list's title as sent ("SAN ANGELO, TX, Sunday, November 1, 2026 through ...").

over_field.description: Whether its area takes the field in.

what.description: Its kind and the rule it is under: "Security TFR, 14 CFR 99.7".

rule.description: The rule it is issued under in words with its section, the FAA's bare number said as the regulation: "Special security instructions, 14 CFR 99.7"; one it does not know as given, in sentence case; null where none is given.

where.description: "3,500 to 18,000 ft MSL, 4.8 nm east of the field"; null where neither is known.

place.description: Its place's name, its dates off: "San Angelo, TX".
